Single source of the ledger enumerations shared by fct_charge.schema.json, bridge_charge_attribution.schema.json, service-authority.json, ref_service_crosswalk.csv and the finance OpenAPI components. Adding a value is a minor change; removing or renaming one is breaking (new major).
title: Ledger enumerations

service_family.description: Charge family (unit of estimate production and supersession, FIN §3.1-§3.2). Unknown billing tuples map to UNMAPPED_BILLABLE_SERVICE and are never dropped.

service_category.description: Coarse grouping exposed as the semantic dimension service_category (API-001). Mapping family -> category is fixed in ref_service_crosswalk and service-authority.json.

basis_class.description: AUTH = authoritative billed row (FIN-002 normalizer); EST = provisional estimate at family-bucket grain (FIN-102); PPA = Bridge prior-period adjustment created by a CARRY_FORWARD decision (FIN-107).

funding_class.description: From balance_source: CONTRACT (capacity, rollover), FREE (free usage), REBATE (rebate-funded), ON_DEMAND (overage, on-demand), UNKNOWN (null or unrecognized). Spend = all classes; capacity drawdown = CONTRACT + FREE + REBATE (G-FIN-04).

billing_channel.description: ORGANIZATION_BILLING = row of OU.USAGE_IN_CURRENCY_DAILY; SEPARATE_INVOICE = marketplace purchase billed outside organization billing (MPUD authority, G-FIN-05); ESTIMATE = EST row; BRIDGE_ADJUSTMENT = PPA row.

charge_null_reason.description: Why cost_effective is NULL (never rendered as zero). BILLING_UNAVAILABLE = no organization billing access and no approved rate table (supersession case 8).

physical_data_status.description: data_status stored on ledger rows. RECONCILED is not stored on rows: serving overlays it per (period, publication) from fct_period_reconciliation_status (FIN-009-S10), avoiding a rebuild loop.

attribution_set.description: Named decomposition of a parent. Level-1 sets decompose a charge; level-2 sets decompose one level-1 row. is_primary marks the one level-1 set per family used by the attributed_cost metric (API G-API-02).

residual_kind.description: UX labels: Unattributed, Idle, Proration residual, Over-attributed, Hidden resource (FIN-103-S09).

attribution_status.description: Attribution maturity (FIN-104): FINAL at the attribution horizon of the detail source (QAH hour_end + T + 24 h, default 72 h) with contiguous coverage.

attribution_reason.description: Reason code on residual rows (and on NULL-amount rows).

idle_status.description: Per warehouse-hour: AVAILABLE (classic), NOT_APPLICABLE (Adaptive warehouses, FIN-004-S05), UNKNOWN (WMH attributed NULL or QAH immature, FIN-003-S08).
